name: Almost Castaways
source:
Two strangers, one mysterious island, and a fate they never saw coming.

When a sudden accident leaves two young women shipwrecked on the shores of a seemingly deserted tropical paradise, survival becomes their only goal. 

But as they navigate the lush jungles and hidden coves, they quickly realize this island holds secrets that defy explanation—and challenges that will test the very core of their bond.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4553070/Almost_Castaways/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
两个陌生人，一个神秘的岛屿，以及他们从未预见到的命运。

当一场突如其来的事故导致两名年轻女子在看似荒芜的热带天堂海岸遭遇海难时，生存成为她们唯一的目标。

但当他们穿越茂密的丛林和隐蔽的海湾时，他们很快意识到这座岛屿蕴藏着无法解释的秘密，以及将考验他们纽带核心的挑战。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4553070/Almost_Castaways/]Steam[/url]]
